title: Splayed-leg stool
description: An oak sitting stool, Ø 340 mm seat at 450 mm, on four legs splayed and raked 10°, tenoned through the seat and wedged with walnut, with two shouldered side stretchers; proven in closed form and against the stool stability test of IS 5416-2.
process: Hand and machine joinery: mortise and tenon, wedged through-tenons, oil finish

difficulty.rationale: Datum planes at compound angles from formulas, multi-body booleans with keepTool for shoulders and wedges, grain per diagonal pair, closed forms across bodies and a two-part stability test from a standard.

standards: BS EN 1729-1, size marks 5 and 6 (seat heights 430 and 460 mm)
NHLA rules, standard surfaced thicknesses of hardwood lumber

prompt_test.model: Claude Sonnet 5.5, medium effort, through craft3d-cli
prompt_test.result: Passed: document.check ok with its own 9 assertions, also at 650/12, 400/5 and 520/7.5; seat 2 633 378.9, legs and wedges 2 426 663.0 and stretchers 329 924.9 mm3, mortise wall 7.57 mm and 4.085 kg, all equal to this example's; about 160 commands. It gave each leg pair its own grain through face.appearance on a selection (see F-083).
